en: "Where in the world is thiiis?"
"Where on earth did Mr. {hero:6}{n} wander off tooo?"
"And what about everyone else?"
"Is that... Diana...?"
"You go on trusting your husband{n} without a shred of doubt, doing{n} nothing but guard his last wishes..."
"Is this... an illusion...?"
"I wanted to be a fool like that too."
"I wanted to trust like an idiot, never{n} noticing the muck hidden deep in the{n} heart of the man who held me."
"Well, that's your way of living too.{n} But someday the time will come to{n} settle it. You know that much, right?"
"It's no illusion... but...{n} it isn't real either, is iiit..."
"That's just it, missus."
"A heart is so vague and flimsy{n} a drug can warp it. Even feelings{n} like love and friendship."
"But now, I think I can finally say{n} the words I've never been able{n} to say all this time..."
"Is that... Hector!?"
"What makes a person a person?{n} Why do people live as people?{n} And where are people headed?"
"I thought maybe I could find{n} the answers I've been searching{n} for all this time."
"Maybe the root of that sin{n} lies in the human heart."
"It isn't progress. The human heart has{n} just grown complex, like a maze,{n} and can't find the way out."
"This has to be... an illusion after aaall!"
"If someone couldn't see or hear,{n} couldn't move, had no words... if a{n} person lost the form of a person..."
"Even then, could you still{n} call that a person?"
"Because... because... Hector...!"
"And yet, even so..."
"Hector... is dead, after all!"
"Where... is thiiis?"
"So... what I saw just now was...?"
"Something's theeere!?"
"{name:6}... I've been waiting...{n} all this time..."
"For you... to come and save me..."
"That voice... that dear, familiar voice..."
"What's wrong... {name:6}...{n} Don't tell me... you've forgotten me?"
"It can't be!? It can't be!? It can't be!?"
"Hector!!"
"I missed you... {name:6}..."
"I really... missed you so much..."
"All this time... I waited on this island..."
"Hector..."
"Is it... really you...?"
"Yeah... it's me... but...{n} ...I can't see you anymore...{n} or hear you... or smell you..."
"But... I can feel you..."
"I missed you... {name:6}..."
"You aren't Hector"
"You're Hector, aren't you?"
"You're just a monster!"
"You are not Hector!"
"That's not true... it's me...{n} {name:6}... I'm your husband, aren't I?{n} That's mean... did you forget...?"
"You really are Hector, aren't you?"
"That's right... it's really me...{n} ...it's Hector...{n} Ahh... you understand now..."
"You're nothing but a monster!"
"That's mean... so mean...{n} ...I'm your husband, aren't I...?{n} Hey, {name:6}... it's the truth..."
"Hector came to this island of steel{n} to search for the path that{n} people ought to walk."
"So how did it come to this!?"
"That stuff... doesn't matter anymore...{n} ...It's got nothing to do with me...{n} Humans... have nothing to do with me."
"There's no answer... anywhere...{n} ...no matter where you look for it.{n} So... none of it... matters anymore."
"Ahaha... that's how it was...{n} ...there never... was one at all."
"An answer that was never there... I...{n} ...was trying to find it, huh.{n} Ahaha... how totally stupid of me..."
"What are you doing, Hector!?"
"The answer... I'd never find it anyway."
"So, {name:6}...{n} you should die too... and have{n} Lord Ymir... make you a Machine Man."
"You'll become... a Machine Man... like me..."
"Then... let's live forever on this island...{n} ...both of us as Machine Men...{n} together... for tens of millennia..."
"This trashy... human form... let's{n} throw it away together... {name:6}...{n} Let's be Machine Men... live together..."
"I see. So it was Ymir, after all."
"He broke your mind, remade your body,{n} kept nothing but your memories,{n} and made a thing very much like you."
"All of it was Ymir's doing!"
"You're wrong... I'm the real me..."
"Hector, once before, you put{n} this question to me."
"If someone couldn't see or hear,{n} couldn't move, had no words... if a{n} person lost the form of a person..."
"Even then, could you still call that{n} a person? That is what you asked."
"I have found my own answer.{n} No... I feel as if I've found it."
"For a person to be a person..."
"It takes a human heart"
"It takes a human body"
"It takes heart and body"
"It takes a human heart..."
"Having lost your human heart, what{n} you are now is just a wicked{n} creature that resembles a person."
"Made by one who calls himself{n} a god: a twisted life{n} brimming with malice."
"A person's worth lies in a noble spirit."
"Anguish, joy, sorrow, anger: they all{n} exist to raise that worth. The human{n} heart is a rough gem, like a pebble."
"It takes a human body..."
"Having lost your human body, what{n} you are now is just a wicked{n} creature that resembles a person."
"Made by one who calls himself{n} a god: a twisted life{n} brimming with malice."
"A person's worth lies in human form."
"Human form gave birth to a noble{n} spirit, defied primal animal instinct,{n} and won the civilization only people have."
"That is the will of nature, chance{n} and necessity, which goes by{n} the name of evolution!"
"It takes a human heart and body..."
"Having lost them both, what{n} you are now is just a wicked{n} creature that resembles a person."
"Made by one who calls himself{n} a god: a twisted life{n} brimming with malice."
"A person's worth lies in the balance{n} of heart and body."
"If heart and body are one, the heart{n} is ruled by that body, and the body{n} in turn is slowly reshaped by the heart."
"The conclusion of two evolutions that{n} support each other: that is what gives{n} rise to the human form and heart."
"You are not Hector!"
"You aren't even a person!"
"The Hector I loved is dead!{n} If he lives anywhere, it is in{n} the world inside my heart!"
"{name:6}... that's mean..."
"I'm... right here, aren't I...?{n} ...So why would you say that?{n} Hey... that's mean... way too mean."
"Please let me through...{n} I will defeat the one who created{n} you with my own hands!"
"No... you can't, {name:6}...{n} ...nobody can beat Lord Ymir...{n} So... I won't let you through."
"Then I'll just have to defeat you!{n} So that no more sad creatures{n} like you are ever created!"
"I will stain these hands with blood!"
"{name:6}...{n} Why are you fighting me...?"
"Then... you're just a human too...{n} ...good for nothing but killing...{n} just... a twisted creature..."
"Even so! I will fiiight!"
"It hurts... it hurts... hey...{n} ...why would you... do something{n} so painful... to your own husband?"
"Please, I beg you, lend me strength!"
"Hector..."
"No, Hector is gone now!"
"What I can believe in is..."
"So this is... all human strength is worth."
"It's worthless... I finally get it...{n} ...just look at me...{n} I'm way better... than a knight's power."
"Let's become Machine Men together!"
"Strong... he's way too strooong!?{n} At this rate, I can't win!"
"Do you hear us, agent of the gods?"
"We are the Zodiac Twelve Gods."
"By our covenant with the agent,{n} we bestow upon you{n} the power of miracles."
"By the power of the Bounty Sword,{n} we restore your spirit and stamina.{n} Fight to your heart's content."
"Your companions, who were sealed{n} in a space of darkness, have been{n} set free. Fight as you will."
"Together with the Bounty Sword,{n} the proof of the agent of the gods,{n} which lies in your hand!"
"Is this the power of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods?"
"Could it be that an agent of the gods{n} is a warrior who stands for humanity,{n} fighting so people can stay people...?"
"No! This is no time for that!{n} Right now, I have to win!"
"Everyone, please lend me your strength!{n} To defeat that wicked creature that{n} kept only Hector's memories!"
"Do you hear us, agent of the gods?"
"We are the Zodiac Twelve Gods."
"By our covenant with the agent,{n} we bestow upon you{n} the power of miracles."
"By the power of the Bounty Sword,{n} we restore your spirit and stamina.{n} Fight to your heart's content."
"We have turned the power of{n} your will into tangible power."
"Deal the finishing blow to the{n} Machine Man, the wicked life{n} an evil god brought forth!"
"Together with the Bounty Sword,{n} the proof of the agent of the gods,{n} which lies in your hand!"
"Is this the power of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods?"
"Could it be that an agent of the gods{n} is a warrior who stands for humanity,{n} fighting so people can stay people...?"
"No! This is no time for that! Now I{n} must defeat that wicked creature{n} that kept only Hector's memories!"
"It hurts... it hurts... it hurts!"
"I won't forgive you... I won't...{n} ...I have to kill you...{n} 'cause... that's human instinct..."
"That's right... so that I can live...{n} ...I have to kill you...{n} 'cause... I'm a person, after all..."
"Hector, by fighting you, I've come{n} to understand what Machine Men mean."
"They are humanity's evil parts piled{n} up, a twisted spirit given shape,{n} foolish humans warped even further."
"That is a Machine Man."
"That is why Machine Men are strong."
"Because they lack kindness, sorrow,{n} nobility, and a loving heart."
"Machine Men are the mirror of our hearts."
"I'm sorry. If it were up to me,{n} I would never have wanted to{n} defeat you..."
"Wicked Machine Man though you are,{n} you're the empty shell of a human spirit{n} with fragments of Hector's memories..."
"Aaah... ah... aaaaah!"
"I... couldn't find it."
"But... you found it..."
"The fate... laid upon people...{n} Where... people are headed...{n} How... people can live as people..."
"You found it..."
"I'm dying..."
"Because my role... is over..."
"You must already know it,{n} even if you haven't noticed yet:"
"that you can walk on past me."
"Chance upon chance gave you strength.{n} And someone you can trust more{n} than me..."
"You've found that someone."
"Go now, {name:6}."
"Down the path you believe in."
"Hector... I'm sorry..."
"When I got word of your death,{n} I decided I would never cry again,{n} buuut here I am, crying after aaall."
"I'm sorry... I'm so sorry..."
"Someone I can trust more than you?"
"That's right!?"
"Where did{n} Mr. {hero:6} go!?"
"I have to find Mr. {hero:6}!"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
